name: docs-standards
description: Standards and an audit workflow for high-quality technical documentation: derive every claim, define before use, illustrate concepts, keep it self-contained, control punctuation rhythm, fix systematically, and verify visuals. Adds the writing-technical-docs skill, the typesetting-documents-as-pdf skill, the documenting-existing-designs skill (provenance-tiered analysis reports and audited block diagrams of inherited code), and a /review-doc command.
